claims.citation: New York Herald, 8 May 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Schr Enchantress, Capt Blanchford[?], was cleared 3d inst,
at Charleston for Havre, with 1232 bales of uplands cotton,
weighing 494,506 pounds; 47 bales Sea Island cotton, weighing
14,697 pounds, making 1279 bales, weighing 509,203 pounds,
valued at $189,400.
